positions.name: RememberAsyncContract
positions.frame: how does the remember contract reconcile immediate return with async extraction?
positions.why: Both expressions address the async job contract for remember: src-1 ratifies the receipt-return, cursor-polling, no-blocking, no-lost-work design; src-2 specifies the agent's retrieval path — poll the run or get the reaction piggybacked on a later call. Together they read in the direction of how immediate return and async extraction are reconciled, with src-2 filling the retrieval-mechanism gap that src-1 leaves open.
